curated_presets.name: NRF2 Redox & Ferroptosis Defense (20-Gene Panel)
curated_presets.description: Curated 20-gene master NRF2-KEAP1 redox buffering, glutathione synthesis, iron storage, and ferroptosis defense panel (18 quantified at protein level; NFE2L2 & SLC7A11 mRNA-only in TMT proteomics).

curated_presets.description: Tests post-translational turnover regulators (NFE2L2, KEAP1, CUL3, SQSTM1, HIF1A, VHL, EGLN1, HIF1AN) alongside canonical protein effectors (NQO1, HMOX1, SLC2A1, LDHA, CA9).

curated_presets.name: Serine Biosynthesis & 1C Metabolism
curated_presets.description: De novo serine synthesis and mitochondrial folate enzymes coupled to NADPH and glutathione production.

curated_presets.name: Hypoxia & Glycolytic Reprogramming
curated_presets.description: Hypoxia-responsive metabolic enzymes and glucose/lactate transporters in desmoplastic PDAC.
